node.title: XR three-anchor rank-two trades factor through dual GRS3
node.statement: Every coefficient-rank-three branch of a uniform rank-two trade has the exact form lambda_i=s_i(P+gamma_i Q)/Lambda'_X for one independent polynomial pair P,Q. The trade scalars are exactly a full-support dual GRS_3 word on the slopes: s_i=H(gamma_i)/L'_Gamma(gamma_i) for one unique polynomial deg H<t-3. Each canonical four-block owner has the corresponding explicit barycentric coefficients. This applies on every active-union shell; realized support embeddings, the coefficient-rank-four branch, first-core ownership, and aggregate payment remain open.
